headline: Broad-based revenue growth lifts margins portfolio-wide
summary_short: General Dynamics reported Q2 2026 revenue of $14,094M (+8.1% y/y) with growth across all four segments, and diluted EPS of $4.24 (+13.4% y/y) as operating margin expanded 40bp to 10.4%.
summary_long: Revenue rose 8.1% y/y to $14,094M with growth in every segment — Aerospace +15.1%, Marine Systems +10.4%, Technologies +4.1%, Combat Systems +0.3%. Operating earnings rose 11.9% to $1,460M as margin expanded 40bp to 10.4%, led by Aerospace (+130bp to 14.5%) and Marine Systems (+40bp to 7.3%); Combat Systems margin slipped to 13.9% from 14.2%. Net earnings were $1,160M, diluted EPS $4.24 (+13.4% y/y). Operating cash flow was $1.9B (162% of net earnings); the company paid $429M in dividends, spent $234M on capex, and cut total debt by $498M, ending the quarter with $7.5B of debt and $4.3B of cash. Backlog reached $136.5B on a 1.4-to-1 book-to-bill. No forward guidance is in this release.

drivers.explanation: Management attributes the quarter to revenue growth across all four segments and ongoing efforts to increase pace of execution and deliver on backlog, citing double-digit revenue growth and margin expansion in Aerospace and Marine Systems.
Growth was broad-based across segments: Aerospace +15.1% and Marine Systems +10.4% led, with Technologies +4.1% and Combat Systems roughly flat (+0.3%).

Company-wide operating margin expanded 40bp to 10.4%, driven by 'noteworthy margin expansion' in Aerospace (14.5% vs 13.2%) and Marine Systems (7.3% vs 6.9%), partly offset by a slight Combat Systems margin decline (13.9% vs 14.2%).

Net earnings grew in line with the operating-earnings increase described above, aided by lower net interest expense ($49M vs $88M a year ago) from debt reduction.
Diluted EPS growth of 13.4% trailed net-income growth of 14.4% slightly, due to a modest rise in diluted share count (273.5M vs 270.9M a year ago).
